apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App Store numeric ids, apps.apple.com links, Google Play package names or play.google.com links. A dotted name that lives in either store is looked up in both.

country.title: Store country
country.description: Two letter store country, for example us, gb, de. Prices, ratings and availability are reported for this country. A full country name is refused before any store is asked.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Language of the Google Play page, for example en or de. The App Store lookup is language neutral.

platform.title: Platform for dotted package names
platform.description: Which store to try when the input is a dotted name such as com.instagram.android. Numeric ids and store links always say the store themselves. both tries Google Play first, then the App Store bundle id.

maxApps.title: Max apps
maxApps.description: How many apps one run reads. The rest come back as free status rows with the reason maxApps.

includeDescription.title: Include the full store description
includeDescription.description: Add the long store description to every delivered row. It is the largest field, so it is off by default.
